verdict.rationale: 1Password documents bulk import from other applications via CSV and, on iOS/iPadOS 26+, directly from apps supporting the Credential Exchange standard. It also stores one-time passwords. However, nothing in the evidence says these imports carry TOTP secrets from authenticator apps specifically. missing for 10: explicit support for importing OTP/TOTP seeds from authenticator apps (e.g., Google Authenticator, Authy), documentation of which authenticator formats are accepted, hands-on corroboration that tokens survive import.

support.subject: As a power user, I can import tokens in bulk from other authenticator apps instead of re-enrolling every account by hand

citations.quote: You can import data into 1Password from many different browsers and applications, including applications that export data in the comma-separated values (CSV) file format
you can import data directly from apps that support the Credential Exchange standard
Learn how to use 1Password to store and quickly access your one-time passwords
